title: Re-generate API resource tokens from an OpenAPI spec

specPath.description: Local path or https:// URL to the OpenAPI 3.x YAML or JSON spec file

outputDir.description: Output directory for generated files (relative to workspace root)

baseUrlToken.description: Name of the InjectionToken holding the API base URL

tagFilter.description: Comma-separated list of OpenAPI tags to include (empty = all tags)

namingConvention.description: File naming convention: kebab-case filenames with SCREAMING_SNAKE token names

providedIn.description: none: export provideX() helpers for scoped provision. root: self-registering singleton.

includeMocks.description: Generate a .mock.ts file per endpoint using @constantant/openapi-resource-mocks. Requires the package to be installed.

specId.description: Identifier for this API spec, embedded in MockResourceMeta and mocks.manifest.json. Defaults to baseUrlToken lowercased with _BASE_URL stripped (e.g. PETSTORE_BASE_URL → petstore).

verbose.description: Print a summary of created, updated, and deleted files after generation.

dateType.description: Convert format:date-time / format:date response fields to Date or Temporal objects. Emits a typed XxxRevived alias and reviveXxxDates() helper per affected endpoint.

readWriteMarkers.description: Honor readOnly / writeOnly in the spec: request body types (XxxBody) drop readOnly properties such as server-generated ids, and response types (XxxResponse, XxxError) drop writeOnly ones such as passwords. Uses openapi-typescript's readWriteMarkers, which adds the Readable<T> / Writable<T> helpers to schema.d.ts.

readonlyResponses.description: Wrap all XxxResponse and XxxError type aliases in Readonly<> to prevent accidental mutation of response data.

includeMswHandlers.description: Generate a .msw.ts file per endpoint (and index.msw.ts barrels) with MSW 2.x http.* handlers. Requires msw to be installed.

clientType.description: HTTP primitive wrapped by generated tokens. httpClient: the token yields a function returning a cold Observable<T> via HttpClient.

reportProgress.description: Emit reportProgress: true on httpResource tokens that upload a binary/multipart body or download a blob, so httpResource().progress() reports transfer progress. Has no effect on httpClient endpoints.

mockHooks.description: Pass every httpResource a token creates to a shared mock-hook.ts, so a mocking tool (@constantant/openapi-resource-mocks or the DevTools extension, also on a production build) can re-run live resources when a mock is edited. Costs one global lookup per created resource when no tool is installed. Defaults to the value of includeMocks.

callOptions.description: Accept a trailing per-call options argument on every token function: HttpContext, headers, withCredentials and the other request fields Angular supports, plus (for httpResource tokens) defaultValue, equal, injector and debugName. A defaultValue narrows the returned resource's value to non-undefined. Emits a shared request-options.ts.

convertSwagger2.description: Convert Swagger 2.0 specs to OpenAPI 3.0 in memory (using @scalar/openapi-upgrader) before generating. Set to false to reject Swagger 2.0 specs instead.

httpClientTags.description: Comma-separated OpenAPI tags whose endpoints use HttpClient, overriding clientType.

httpClientOperations.description: Comma-separated operationIds that use HttpClient, overriding clientType.

check.description: Write nothing; list what would change and fail if the generated output is out of date (for CI).

navigationOperations.description: Comma-separated operationIds that are browser navigations (a redirect such as an OAuth login). Their token is a URL builder (args) => string instead of a request. Operations with x-navigation: true, or a GET that only answers 3xx, are detected without this.

serverVariables.description: Emit one InjectionToken per variable of the first servers[] entry (server-variables.token.ts) and build the default base URL token from them, so the host, region or version can be overridden per environment.

validateResponses.description: Validate JSON responses at runtime against the spec's response schema via httpResource's parse hook, throwing on mismatch. Requires @cfworker/json-schema to be installed. Endpoints whose response schema has a circular $ref are skipped.

overlay.description: Comma-separated paths of OpenAPI Overlay 1.0 documents (YAML or JSON), applied to the spec in order before generating. Use them to add operationIds, fix wrong types or remove operations without editing a spec you do not own. A target that matches nothing is an error.

stripPathPrefix.description: Path prefix left out of the operationIds derived for operations that have none: with /api, GET /api/pets/{id} becomes get_pets_id (token GET_PETS_ID) instead of get_api_pets_id.

includeOperations.description: Comma-separated "METHOD /path" entries or operationIds: generate only these operations. Errors if an entry matches no operation.

excludeOperations.description: Comma-separated "METHOD /path" entries or operationIds to leave out (e.g. "GET /sitemap.xml"). Errors if an entry matches no operation.

excludeSecuritySchemes.description: Comma-separated security scheme names to drop, or * for all: no security token is emitted for them and every security alternative that names one is removed, so tokens never send those credentials (use it when an interceptor adds auth).
